items.author: Kyle Cheung (CEO, Greybeam), around Oct 29
items.summary: Agents that answer plain-language questions are finally making self-serve analytics real. He points to Hex's $100M raise and asks whether BI vendors that bolt a chat sidebar onto dashboards can keep up. 74 reactions, 22 comments.

items.author: Mikhail Christiansen, Oct 30
items.summary: His CPI "Friday Dashboard" shows that one missing month in BLS data makes row-based year-over-year inflation read 3.1% instead of 2.4%, which misstates ten months. 8 reactions, 2 comments.

items.author: Natalia Silva (Nextant), around Oct 27
items.summary: Now that Claude builds dashboards, dashboards are a commodity. The value is in trusted data, shared definitions and the decision the dashboard enables. 25 reactions, 2 comments.

items.author: Leon Gordon (6x Microsoft MVP), around Oct 28
items.summary: Starting Nov 2, Microsoft turns on NL2SQL and DAX generation for Fabric data agents by default. He gives five steps to build a test baseline first. 43 reactions, 1 comment.

items.author: Murtaza Ul Hasan (WestJet), Oct 29
items.summary: Copilot plus the Power BI Authoring MCP server lets an agent inspect semantic models and refactor DAX. He advises using a dev copy, keeping it in Git and checking the output. 39 reactions, 3 comments.
